game_title: Return Or Print – Blizzard Bridge Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Snowy Hold – Blizzard Bridge, a bridge in a blizzard: the innkeeper must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Or Print: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on.
theme: Snowy Hold – Blizzard Bridge: a bridge in a blizzard
core_gameplay_loop: In Blizzard Bridge, repeat each round: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on. Each round, snow wraiths strike the hold gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the court_score value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the hold gate from snow wraiths in Blizzard Bridge: keep the court_score meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 38-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: court_score drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 38-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 7 (applied tier): Return Or Print
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Return Or Print' (Week 6 slot 15), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Blizzard Bridge'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how court_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow wraiths in Blizzard Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 38 seconds while court_score > 0.
